title: ILLINOIS TeX
summary: SIAM IIT and the Student Committee on Research Affairs revived and updated an older Illinois Tech Applied Mathematics resource introducing students to TeX and LaTeX.
history: The project continued a much older Illinois Tech tradition of maintaining mathematical computing resources for students. A surviving Internet Archive snapshot from June 13, 2015 preserves an earlier 'TeX or LaTeX Introduction' page within the former Illinois Tech Applied Mathematics website. In 2024, SIAM IIT and the Student Committee on Research Affairs returned to that earlier resource and reformulated it for a new generation of students.
archival_note: The June 13, 2015 date identifies a surviving Internet Archive capture and should not be interpreted as the original publication date of the predecessor resource. No evidence currently establishes SIAM IIT involvement in the 2015 page.
